# 0.9.1-beta01

> **Beta.** Tested on a real phone, but still report what breaks on GitHub. Installs as **Editotsu β** and updates beta04 in place.

- **New Features:**
  - Watch next on home: sequels of shows you finished and related shows on your list, with why each one is there. It takes Planned Anime's place
  - Continue watching plays the next episode in one tap from the source you used last, and opens the picker when that source fails
  - Search from home looks through anime, manga, characters, staff, studios and users at once; search from the anime or manga tab stays on that type
  - Search filters fit on one screen: sort, format, status, season, year, source and country as chips, genres and tags grouped by category, a reset button, and the filters you set show as chips you can clear
  - New profile: a new header, stats charts, and cleaner activity cards
  - Settings are grouped into sections, notifications have their own screen, and search results open the right row
  - Covers show when the next episode airs ("Ep 8 · in 2d") under the title, and the unseen episode count sits on the cover
  - Redesigned extensions, downloads and openings & endings screens
  - Swipe between installed and available extensions, and between the profile and notification tabs; reorder extensions with a long-press
  - The source picker's filters and sort open inside the picker
  - On a torrent, the seek bar shows how much has downloaded ahead of you
  - Picture-in-picture has seek buttons
  - Progress can update MyAnimeList too (Settings › Accounts & tracking)
  - Discord: View Anime and Get Editotsu buttons, a bigger pause icon, and "Reading chapter" while you read manga
  - Home rows line up: headers, covers and titles start at the same edge

- **Bugfixes:**
  - Searching settings and tapping a result no longer crashes or skips the highlight
  - Picture-in-picture no longer shows a broken frame after pausing
  - Rescue mode works without a MyAnimeList account
  - The ring around your own story shows on light themes
  - A locked player no longer shows play, pause and episode buttons when you tap it
  - Play and pause respond the moment you tap
  - Switching search between all, anime and manga no longer crashes
  - An opening or ending you leave before it loads no longer starts playing in the background
  - The update badge on the Extensions tabs no longer covers the tab name

- **Known issues:**
  - If the AniList sign-in page sticks on the security check, tap the browser icon at the top to finish signing in
  - A torrent you haven't played before can take a while to start on a slow swarm, and long seeks are slow
  - AnimeThemes can take up to a minute the first time you open a show
  - Not redesigned yet: the scanlator filter, episode options, the comments header, and the activity and offline pages
  - The Degoogle'd build has no in-app updater
  - Pink light theme is low contrast in places
